# Telar — Project Documentation Index

*Generated by the BMad document-project workflow — deep scan, 2026-07-17.*

This is the master entry point for AI-assisted development on Telar. Point brownfield PRD / planning workflows here.

## Project Overview

- **Type:** Monorepo (Bun workspaces: `apps/*`, `packages/*`) with 3 parts
- **Primary Language:** TypeScript (Bun runtime/tooling)
- **Architecture:** Loom engine library (`@telar/core`) consumed in-process by a Next.js cockpit, wrapped by a minimal Electron shell
- **Thesis:** "Generation is solved; verification is the moat." Looms are self-verifying units of work; a read-only Verifier gates progress and a human always accepts — there is no agent-callable accept.

## Quick Reference

### Web (`web`) — `apps/web`

- **Type:** web (Next.js App Router)
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (canary), React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn "base-nova" on `@base-ui/react`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, streamdown
- **Entry Point:** `apps/web/app/layout.tsx`
- **Shape:** 11 routes, 56 API route files (63 handlers), hand-rolled SSE streaming (`lib/sse.ts`); no auth (local single-user cockpit); `@telar/core` runs server-side only (CLIENT-BUNDLE RULE: client files use type-only imports)

### Desktop (`desktop`) — `apps/desktop`

- **Type:** desktop (Electron shell)
- **Tech Stack:** Electron, electron-builder
- **Entry Point:** `apps/desktop/main.js`
- **Shape:** forks the packaged Next standalone server and opens one BrowserWindow; no custom menus/tray/IPC; `--smoke` is the fail-closed packaging gate

### Core (`core`) — `packages/core`

- **Type:** library (TypeScript domain engine)
- **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Bun test runner, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, zod, yaml
- **Entry Point:** `packages/core/src/index.ts` (single package export)
- **Shape:** 59 source modules, 98 test files; deterministic tick-loop weaver, verifier/critic-panel stack, environment lanes, MCP OAuth 2.1 client, filesystem store under `TELAR_HOME` (~/.telar)

## Getting Started

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh).

```bash
bun install                 # install all workspaces
cd apps/web && bun run dev  # cockpit at localhost:3000 (TELAR_HOME defaults to ~/.telar-dev)
cd packages/core && bun test  # run the core engine suite (98 files)
bash scripts/build-desktop.sh # full desktop packaging pipeline (smoke-gated)
```

See the [Development Guide](./development-guide.md) for environment configuration and the full command reference.

## AI-Assisted Development Guidance

- **Planning a brownfield PRD:** start from this index; the per-part architecture docs plus [Integration Architecture](./integration-architecture.md) are the load-bearing context.
- **UI-only features:** [Architecture — Web](./architecture-web.md) + [Component Inventory — Web](./component-inventory-web.md) (respect the status-tone vocabularies and the CLIENT-BUNDLE RULE).
- **Engine features:** [Architecture — Core](./architecture-core.md) + [Data Models](./data-models-web.md); note the design law — deterministic control flow in code, intelligence in the leaves.
- **API changes:** [API Contracts — Web](./api-contracts-web.md); the human-accept moat is structurally enforced — do not add agent-callable accept paths.
- **Scan state:** [project-scan-report.json](./project-scan-report.json) records what was scanned and when (resume/rescan metadata).
